target.description: Only the watches stored with exactly this target: an address, a type prefix or `*`.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 1000; 100 by default.

WatchViewPage.description:
One page of a listing (`GET /actors`, `GET /actors/{type}/{key}/children`, `GET /actors/{type}/{key}/mailbox`,
`GET /messages`, `GET /outcomes`, `GET /turns`, `GET /watches`).

Paging: pass [`Self::next`] back as the `cursor` query parameter to get the following page; it is null on the last
page. The page size is the `limit` query parameter (1..1000, default 100).

items.description: Items of this page, in the listing's order.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null when this is the last one.

WatchView.description: A stored watch (`GET /watches`, `PUT /watches`): `watcher` is told of the events of `target`.

target.description:
What is watched: an address (`type/key`), a type prefix that ends at a dot (`billing` matches `billing` and
`billing.invoices`), or `*` for every type.

WatchRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /watches`. The watcher must exist and its type must declare the messages `Failed` and `Stopped`; the
target need not exist.

target.description: What to watch: an address, a type prefix or `*`; anything else is `400`.
The target of the watch: an address, a type prefix or `*`.

RegisterTypeRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /types/{name}`: the schemas of a contract to register without hosting its type. Both fields are
required; the name comes from the path and the server computes the hash, so neither is a field.

state.description: JSON Schema of the state: an object or a boolean.

messages.description: JSON Schema per message type name, each an object or a boolean; may be empty.

CreateActorRequest.description: Body of `PUT /actors/{type}/{key}`. The state is required: a body without it, or an empty body, is a `400`.

state.description:
Initial state; never null. A type that keeps no data takes `{}`. It must match the state schema of the type
(`GET /types/{name}`), or the create is refused with `422 invalid-state`.

pinnedTo.description:
Optional claim owner (node or worker id) the new instance is pinned to (ADR 0052): only that owner may run its
turns. At most 200 characters, no NUL; absent or null for none, and left out when none. An instance that exists
already keeps its own pin: read it with `GET /actors/{type}/{key}`.

CreateActorResponse.description: Response of `PUT /actors/{type}/{key}`: `201` when [`Self::created`], `200` when the instance already existed (unchanged).

created.description: True when this request created the instance.

prefix.description: A prefix of the address: `sync/` is one type, `sync/ac` a key prefix.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 1000; 100 by default.

RunningTurnView.description: A turn running now, as listed by `GET /turns` and served by `GET /actors/{type}/{key}/turn`.

cancelRequested.description: True when an operator asked to cancel this turn.

prefix.description: A literal prefix of the address, as for `GET /actors` (`sync/`, `sync/ac`); all actors when absent or empty.

status.description: Only outcomes of this status: `done`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `purged`; all by default.

prefix.description: A prefix of the address: `sync/` is one type, `sync/ac` a key prefix.

since.description: Only messages that finished at or after this instant.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 1000; 100 by default.

OutcomeView.description: A retained outcome, as listed by `GET /outcomes`.

error.description: The error of a failed message.

message.description: The envelope as it left the mailbox.

prefix.description: A prefix of the address: `sync/` is one type, `sync/ac` a key prefix.

StatsView.description: Response of `GET /stats`: what is stored under an address prefix.

pending.description: The number of pending messages, including one being handled and delayed ones.

oldestDue.description: The earliest delivery time of a pending message that is due now; null when none is due.

NodeView.description: A node, as listed by `GET /nodes`. Display only; leases decide who runs what.

hosted.description: The names of the types it hosts; empty for a send-only node.

startedAt.description: Store time of its first heartbeat.

lastSeen.description: Store time of its latest heartbeat.

status.description: `alive` (seen under 30 s ago), `suspect` (under 2 min ago) or `dead`, in the store's clock.

runningTurns.description: The number of its turns running now.

hostname.description:
The OS host name the node reported, absent when its lookup gave none or an older node wrote the row. It may
identify a machine or container; it is not authenticated and not an identity.

cicadaVersion.description: The version of the `cicada` crate the node was built with, not that of its application.

label.description: The label the node was configured with.

NodeHealth.description: How long ago a node last reported itself, in the store's clock; display only.

oneOf.description: Last seen less than 30 s ago.
Last seen less than 2 min ago.
Last seen 2 min ago or more.

hosted.description: The names of the types it hosts; empty for a send-only node.

startedAt.description: Store time of its first heartbeat.

lastSeen.description: Store time of its latest heartbeat.

status.description: `alive` (seen under 30 s ago), `suspect` (under 2 min ago) or `dead`, in the store's clock.

runningTurns.description: The number of its turns running now.

hostname.description:
The OS host name the node reported, absent when its lookup gave none or an older node wrote the row. It may
identify a machine or container; it is not authenticated and not an identity.

cicadaVersion.description: The version of the `cicada` crate the node was built with, not that of its application.

label.description: The label the node was configured with.

node.description: Only turns held by this node.

prefix.description: A prefix of the address: `sync/` is one type, `sync/ac` a key prefix.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 1000; 100 by default.

RunningTurnViewPage.description:
One page of a listing (`GET /actors`, `GET /actors/{type}/{key}/children`, `GET /actors/{type}/{key}/mailbox`,
`GET /messages`, `GET /outcomes`, `GET /turns`, `GET /watches`).

Paging: pass [`Self::next`] back as the `cursor` query parameter to get the following page; it is null on the last
page. The page size is the `limit` query parameter (1..1000, default 100).

items.description: Items of this page, in the listing's order.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, or null when this is the last one.

status.description: Always `up`; an unhealthy node answers `503` with a problem.

state.description: Life-cycle state of the node's runtime (`STARTED`, …).

SendRequest.description:
Body of `POST /actors/{type}/{key}/messages`.

Delivery time is optional and given either as an absolute [`Self::deliver_at`] or as a relative [`Self::delay`],
never both. A delay is an ISO-8601 duration string (`"PT5S"`); a negative one is `400`. A past `deliverAt` means
"now".

id.description: Dedup key; generated by the server when absent. Reuse it when retrying a send.

type.description: Message type name, as listed in the target type's contract.

payload.description:
The message's JSON (without type tag). Defaults to `{}`. It must match the schema of its message type
(`GET /types/{name}`), or the send is refused with `422 invalid-payload`.

delay.description: Relative delivery time, as an ISO-8601 duration.

retry.description:
The message's retry policy, e.g. `{"maxAttempts": 4, "backoff": {"kind": "exponential", "initial": "PT1S",
"max": "PT1M"}}`; absent for no retry. An invalid policy is `400`. Ignored on a duplicate send.

retention.description:
How long the message's record is kept once it finished, e.g. `{"done": {"kind": "remove"}}`; absent for the
store default. An invalid policy is `400`. Ignored on a duplicate send.

SendResponse.description: Response of `POST /actors/{type}/{key}/messages`: `202` when accepted, `200` when the id was already accepted.

deliverAt.description: Effective delivery time (store time); null for a duplicate whose original is no longer known.

purged.description: The number of messages that received outcome `purged`.

BulkRequest.description:
Body of `POST /messages/bulk-cancel` and `POST /messages/bulk-retry`: either [`Self::ids`] or a filter, a
[`Self::prefix`] and/or a [`Self::message_type`], not both and not neither.

ids.description: The messages to act on, at most 1000.

prefix.description: Only messages of actors whose address starts with this.

affected.description: How many messages were acted on; ones that were not eligible are not counted.

more.description: True when matches remain beyond the cap of 1000 per call.

LeaseTurnsRequest.description: Body of `POST /leases`: lease up to `limit` due turns of `types` for `owner`.

owner.description: The worker that will hold the leases, recorded as their owner: at most 200 characters, no NUL.

types.description:
Each selected type name with the contract hash the worker was built with; 1 to 100 types (`MAX_LEASE_TYPES`).
A type that is not registered with exactly that hash answers `contractMismatch` and nothing is leased.

limit.description: The most turns to lease, 1 to 100 (`MAX_LEASE_BATCH`).

oneOf.description: The leased turns, at most the limit; empty when nothing was due (no long poll).
A selected type is not registered with the requested hash; nothing was leased.

type.description: The first such type in name order.

registered.description: The registered hash, or null when the type is not registered; required.

requested.description: The hash the worker asked for.

TurnLeaseView.description:
A leased turn ([`TurnLease`]): everything a worker needs to run it. The worker keeps its own deadline: its
monotonic time when it sent the lease request plus `ttl`, less the smaller of a tenth of it and one second.

actor.description: The leased actor; echo it as it is.

epoch.description: The fencing token of the lease.

message.description: The head message, with `attempt` already counting this lease.

claimedAt.description: Store time at the claim; the handler's `now`.

leaseUntil.description: Store time at which the lease expires unless renewed; for display, not a deadline.

ttl.description: The TTL the server asked the store for, as an ISO-8601 duration.

TurnMessageView.description:
A message as a worker runs it ([`Message`]): the fields of [`MessageView`](super::MessageView), every one required
(nullable ones as `null`, counters also when 0) and the policies decoded strictly.

correlationId.description: Opaque string passed through, or null.

attempt.description: Number of claims, this lease included.

failures.description: Number of failed runs that were retried.

lostClaims.description: Number of claims another claim replaced.

lastError.description: The error of the most recent retried failure, or null.

causedBy.description: The message whose turn sent this one, or null.

retention.description: The retention of the record, or null.

notification.description: True for a notification of a watch.

RenewTurnRequest.description: Body of `POST /leases/renew`: renew the lease of `actor` held under `epoch`.

actor.description: The leased actor, as the lease named it.

oneOf.description: The lease is extended.

leaseUntil.description: Store time at which the lease now expires: never earlier than before.

ttl.description: The TTL the server asked the store for.

cancelRequested.description: An operator asked to cancel this turn; the lease is extended all the same.

oneOf.description: The epoch is no longer current or its lease was released, completed or deleted: abandon the turn.

ReleaseTurnRequest.description: Body of `POST /leases/release`: give back the lease of `actor` held under `epoch`, without an outcome.

actor.description: The leased actor, as the lease named it.

CompleteTurnRequest.description:
Body of `POST /leases/complete`: complete the leased turn of `actor` under `epoch` on `messageId` with the report of
its handler. The server derives the outcome; a report names none.

actor.description: The leased actor, as the lease named it.

TurnReportView.description: How the handler of a leased turn ended ([`TurnReport`]), tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: The handler returned: its state and its effects, applied together or not at all.

state.description: What happens to the actor's own state.

effects.description: The effects the handler buffered; required, each of its arrays optional.

oneOf.description:
The handler failed, or the turn failed around it; no effects. Only `handler`, `node` and `timeout` may be
retryable, and `claim-limit` cannot be reported.

The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The message cannot be decoded.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
The message reached the claim limit (ADR 0025).

retryable.description: True when the message's own retry policy may reschedule it.

reason.description: The reason it is recorded with.

oneOf.description: An operator's cancel request came before the handler ended; no effects.

StateReportView.description: What a returned handler did to its actor's own state ([`StateReport`]), tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: State and version stay as they are.

The new state, written with the version increased by 1; required, also when it is `null` (which fails the
message as a state that cannot be stored).
The actor and its descendants stop.

TurnEffectsView.description:
The effects of a returned handler ([`TurnEffects`]), applied by the commit in the order the core gives them:
watches, deletes, creates, purges, pauses and resumes, then sends. Each array is optional and empty by default.

sends.description: The messages to send, in order.

cancels.description: Pending messages of the actor to cancel.

watches.description: The watches set and removed, with the actor as watcher, in the order of the calls.

TurnSendView.description:
A message a returned handler sends ([`TurnSend`]). The server sets its sender to the leased actor and its cause to
the leased message; the id is the worker's and is never generated.

id.description: The message id, drawn once by the worker and kept when it repeats the report.

deliverAt.description: Optional absolute delivery time; not together with [`Self::delay`]. Neither means now.

delay.description: Optional relative delivery time, as an ISO-8601 duration.

headers.description: Optional headers passed through; `{}` by default, never null.

retry.description: Optional retry policy of the new message, as for a send.

retention.description: Optional retention of the new message's record, as for a send.

ActorCreateView.description: An actor a returned handler creates ([`ActorCreate`]).

child.description: True for a child of the leased actor, false for an independent actor.

pinnedTo.description:
Optional claim owner the new actor is pinned to (ADR 0052): at most 200 characters, no NUL. Absent or null for
none, and left out when none.

WatchChangeView.description: A watch a returned handler sets or removes, with the leased actor as watcher ([`WatchChange`]).

set.description: True to set the watch, false to remove it.

ControlView.description: A control effect of a returned handler on an actor ([`Control`]).

oneOf.description: No new turn is claimed for the actor.
Turns of the actor are claimed again.
Every pending message of the actor except one being handled ends `purged`.
The actor, its mailbox and its descendants go.
The commit applied ([`TurnCompletion`]).

outcome.description: How the message ended, or that it was rescheduled.

cause.description: Why it failed, for a `failed` outcome; null otherwise, and required.

anyOf.description:
Why a message ended `failed` (ADR 0028). The node decides it where it decides that the message fails. Written in
kebab-case, in place in the schema of [`Failed`]. A closed set: a value added later changes the contract of every
type that watches.

oneOf.description:
The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The message cannot be decoded.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
The message reached the claim limit (ADR 0025).

version.description: The actor's version after the commit.

cancelled.description: The cancels that found a pending message.

oneOf.description:
Nothing was applied and no failure was committed: report `failed` with this failure next, and from then on only
that report.
The lease is not held (any more): nothing was applied by this call, which says nothing about an earlier one.

TurnOutcomeView.description: How a completed commit ended the message ([`TurnOutcome`]), tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: Outcome `done`.
Outcome `cancelled`.
Outcome `failed`.

Put back into the mailbox by its retry policy, without an outcome. The retry is due at `deliverAt`, after
`delay`, or now when neither is given; never both.

The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The message cannot be decoded.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
